value.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for iterative RPO preference curation, rubric-judge calibration gating against deterministic verifiers and pre-registered holdout flywheel promotion
value.lets_workers: Curate (prompt, chosen_verified, rejected_tombstone) preference pairs using Iterative RPO scoring (DPO logistic loss plus per-token NLL_chosen regularization to prevent chosen log-probability collapse), filter length-ratio verbosity bias and 3-key structural duplicates, gate synthetic self-rewarding rubric pairs against deterministic verifiers via Cohen's kappa and false-positive caps, and evaluate generation rounds against pre-registered holdout SHA-256 locks.

flow.when: Measure candidate self-rewarding rubric judge agreement (Cohen's kappa, exact agreement and false-positive approval rate) against deterministic verifiers before admitting synthetic pairs.
Score verified and calibrated preference pairs with Iterative RPO (DPO margin + alpha * NLL_chosen), filter length-ratio bias and deduplicate across three structural keys.
Independently verify holdout SHA-256 locks, sanity retention bounds, regression caps, distinct reviewer identity and ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate conformance.

value.worked_example: Synthetic rubric calibration, Iterative RPO pair curation and holdout promotion bundle recomputed in test_iterative_rpo_flywheel.py: approves calibrated judge (kappa 0.75, FPR 0.0) while blocking 100% of pairs from uncalibrated judge (kappa -0.2), rejects 1 length-biased pair, 1 chosen-logp-collapse trap and 1 3-key structural duplicate, curates 2 clean pairs (mean DPO margin 0.925, mean RPO loss 0.743994), and verifies SHA-256 holdout lock with +0.20 net gain and 0.0 regression rate.
